subject: Neighborhood Residential Zoning Proposal
overview: The committee reviewed an initial zoning overhaul proposal for neighborhood residential districts presented by Innes Associates. The committee voted to scale back the proposed density tiers across several single-family neighborhoods and approved a request for improved public outreach.

items.title: Zoning ordinance updates: Neighborhood Residential districts
items.summary: Innes Associates presented a draft framework to replace single-family zoning districts with tiered neighborhood residential zones allowing accessory dwelling units and historic conversions.

items.title: Committee motions on zoning tiers and communications
items.summary: Approved an amendment to scale down proposed residential density tiers across several neighborhoods, and approved a motion requesting that council leadership coordinate with the city administration to improve public communication.

items.title: Public participation
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns regarding neighborhood impacts, notification procedures, density near private ways and transit, and lot subdivision rules.
